name: Windrow
description: Tall curved blades of grass two to a cell, rooted along each row and leaning together as gusts move over the field.

code.style: --rule: ( @random(${shapeFrequency}) { z-index: @y; --a: @rn(-38, 38, 1.3); :before { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 18%; bottom: 0; width: 22%; height: 160%; background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); -webkit-clip-path: polygon(0 100%, 34% 46%, 80% 0, 52% 48%, 46% 100%); clip-path: polygon(0 100%, 34% 46%, 80% 0, 52% 48%, 46% 100%); -webkit-transform-origin: 20% 100%; transform-origin: 20% 100%; -webkit-transform: rotate($deg(a - 6)); transform: rotate($deg(a - 6)); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } :after { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 56%; bottom: 0; width: 22%; height: 132%; background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); -webkit-clip-path: polygon(0 100%, 34% 46%, 80% 0, 52% 48%, 46% 100%); clip-path: polygon(0 100%, 34% 46%, 80% 0, 52% 48%, 46% 100%); -webkit-transform-origin: 20% 100%; transform-origin: 20% 100%; -webkit-transform: rotate($deg(a + 6)); transform: rotate($deg(a + 6)); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box; } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
